capabilities: Pull GA4 visitor and page metrics
Write metrics into daily note properties
Embed a refreshable live traffic block
extras: Requires setting up Google Cloud OAuth desktop client and refresh token for GA4/Search Console; secrets can be kept in Obsidian 1.11.4+ Secret Storage. README also promotes the author's other plugins and themes.
problem: Website traffic metrics from analytics services live in separate dashboards and cannot be charted or logged inside vault notes.

requires.name: Google Analytics 4 and/or Google Search Console account

summary: Plugin that pulls Google Analytics 4, Search Console, Plausible and PostHog traffic metrics into Markdown tables and daily note properties.
